import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1 << 29;
    static int MAXN, MAXE;
    static int[] head, to, cap, fl, nxt;
    static int ecnt;
    static int[] d, ptr;
    static int n, t, sx, sy;
    static int[][] temp;
    static boolean[][] m;

    static void add_edge(int a, int b, int c) {
        to[ecnt] = b;
        cap[ecnt] = c;
        fl[ecnt] = 0;
        nxt[ecnt] = head[a];
        head[a] = ecnt++;

        to[ecnt] = a;
        cap[ecnt] = 0;
        fl[ecnt] = 0;
        nxt[ecnt] = head[b];
        head[b] = ecnt++;
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Queue<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(0);
        Arrays.fill(d, -1);
        d[0] = 0;
        int sink = n * n * 2 + 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty() && d[sink] == -1) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (int id = head[v]; id != -1; id = nxt[id]) {
                int tov = to[id];
                if (d[tov] == -1 && fl[id] < cap[id]) {
                    q.add(tov);
                    d[tov] = d[v] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return d[sink] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int flow) {
        if (flow == 0) return 0;
        int sink = n * n * 2 + 1;
        if (v == sink) return flow;
        for (int id = ptr[v]; id != -1; id = nxt[id]) {
            int tov = to[id];
            if (d[tov] != d[v] + 1) continue;
            int pushed = dfs(tov, Math.min(flow, cap[id] - fl[id]));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                fl[id] += pushed;
                fl[id ^ 1] -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int max_flow() {
        int flow = 0;
        int sink = n * n * 2 + 1;
        while (bfs()) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= sink; i++) ptr[i] = head[i];
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = dfs(0, INF)) > 0) {
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static int way(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(new int[]{0, x1, y1});
        int[][] h = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(h[i], INF);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int v = cur[0], x = cur[1], y = cur[2];
            h[x][y] = v;
            if (x > 0 && m[x-1][y] && h[x-1][y] > v+1) {
                boolean target = (x-1 == x2 && y == y2);
                int lim = temp[x-1][y];
                if ((target && lim >= v+1) || (!target && lim > v+1))
                    q.add(new int[]{v+1, x-1, y});
            }
            if (y > 0 && m[x][y-1] && h[x][y-1] > v+1) {
                boolean target = (x == x2 && y-1 == y2);
                int lim = temp[x][y-1];
                if ((target && lim >= v+1) || (!target && lim > v+1))
                    q.add(new int[]{v+1, x, y-1});
            }
            if (x < n-1 && m[x+1][y] && h[x+1][y] > v+1) {
                boolean target = (x+1 == x2 && y == y2);
                int lim = temp[x+1][y];
                if ((target && lim >= v+1) || (!target && lim > v+1))
                    q.add(new int[]{v+1, x+1, y});
            }
            if (y < n-1 && m[x][y+1] && h[x][y+1] > v+1) {
                boolean target = (x == x2 && y+1 == y2);
                int lim = temp[x][y+1];
                if ((target && lim >= v+1) || (!target && lim > v+1))
                    q.add(new int[]{v+1, x, y+1});
            }
        }
        return h[x2][y2];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        int totalNodes = n * n * 2 + 2;
        MAXN = totalNodes;
        MAXE = 500000; // enough for n <= 10
        head = new int[MAXN];
        to = new int[MAXE];
        cap = new int[MAXE];
        fl = new int[MAXE];
        nxt = new int[MAXE];
        d = new int[MAXN];
        ptr = new int[MAXN];
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        ecnt = 0;

        temp = new int[n][n];
        m = new boolean[n][n];

        // read first grid
        int k = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                temp[i][j] = t;
                if (ch == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                    m[i][j] = false;
                } else if (ch == 'Y') {
                    m[i][j] = false;
                } else {
                    m[i][j] = true;
                }
                int capVal = (ch == 'Z' || ch == 'Y') ? 0 : (ch - '0');
                add_edge(0, k++, capVal);
            }
        }

        // read second grid
        k = n * n + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                int capVal = (ch == 'Z' || ch == 'Y') ? 0 : (ch - '0');
                add_edge(k++, n * n * 2 + 1, capVal);
            }
        }

        // BFS from start to compute temp (time to reach each cell)
        Queue<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(new int[]{0, sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int v = cur[0], x = cur[1], y = cur[2];
            temp[x][y] = v;
            if (x > 0 && v + 1 < temp[x-1][y] && m[x-1][y])
                q.add(new int[]{v+1, x-1, y});
            if (y > 0 && v + 1 < temp[x][y-1] && m[x][y-1])
                q.add(new int[]{v+1, x, y-1});
            if (x < n-1 && v + 1 < temp[x+1][y] && m[x+1][y])
                q.add(new int[]{v+1, x+1, y});
            if (y < n-1 && v + 1 < temp[x][y+1] && m[x][y+1])
                q.add(new int[]{v+1, x, y+1});
        }

        // add edges between first and second grid nodes
        k = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int k1 = n * n;
                k++;
                for (int z = 0; z < n; z++) {
                    for (int w = 0; w < n; w++) {
                        k1++;
                        if (m[i][j] && m[z][w] && way(i, j, z, w) <= t)
                            add_edge(k, k1, INF);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(max_flow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
